Definition: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate:--form.
BiblicalUsage: Plasso means to mould, to form as a potter forms clay. Paul asks in Romans 9:20 whether the thing formed may question him who formed it, and says Adam was first formed, then Eve, in 1 Timothy 2:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe I am formed, not self-made, and the order of the forming still matters.
